test_title: PYST 62: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: What sum (in ₹) will earn a simple interest of ₹360 in 2 years at 20% per year rate of interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹360

Time (t) = 2 years

Rate of Interest (R) = 20% per year

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × R × t) / 100

Where, P = Principal amount

**Calculation:**

360 = (P × 20 × 2) / 100

⇒ 360 = (P × 40) / 100

⇒ P = (360 × 100) / 40

⇒ P = 900

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
